title: Chillet Mod!
description: A simple-ish mod that adds Chillet from Palworld!
body:
![A logo for the mod, says the title.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/519c8b20e6a0911c31efb5f4a035a02f9be4435b.png)

A relatively simple and lightweight mod that adds a ridable Chillet and Chillet Ignis from the game [Palworld](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623730/Palworld/)!



Features:

Press [R] to shoot a projectile while riding!

Press [SPACE] to jump while riding!

Chillet/Chillet Ignis Plushie blocks!

Command Chillet/Chillet Ignis to sit in place by Right-Clicking them while Shifted with a "Command Bell"



How to tame:

Chillet - any raw fish (NO PUFFERFISH!!!)

Chillet Ignis - Any cooked food  

 

Where to find:

Chillet - Frozen Ocean, Frozen Peaks, Frozen River, Ice Spikes, Snowy Slopes, Snowy Beach, Snowy Plains, and Snowy Taiga

Chillet Ignis - Cherry Grove

 

Notes:

This is a fan-made mod, and is not affiliated with Pocketpair.

All models, animations, etc, are original.
